name: Night-Sinking Starlight
overview: In her past life, Xia Xingmian had been under Xie Jinchen's control. Locked up and miserable, she escaped him to live with her family, only to be murdered by them for her inheritance. After she passed, her wandering soul witnessed how the obsessive and mad Xie Jinchen avenged her and committed suicide to join her. Reborn with memories of both lives, Xia Xingmian vows to be good to Xie Jinchen and to take revenge on her murderers. In this life, she no longer avoids Xie Jinchen's morbidly passionate emotions; instead, she actively approaches him, taking complete control of his madness.
